what: Simulate log-returns from a stochastic volatility model — sim_sv
title: Simulate log-returns from a stochastic volatility model — sim_sv
text: function draws initial log-volatility (h_t) stationary distribution, meaning h_0 drawn gaussian distribution mean zero standard deviation sigma_h / sqrt(1 - phi^2). h_{t+1} simulated conditional distribution given h_t, N(phi*h_t, sigma_h). Log-returns (y_t) simulated conditional distribution given latent process h. model = "gaussian", y_t given h_t gaussian mean zero standard deviation equal sigma_y*exp(h_t / 2). Heavy tail returns can obtained simulating t-distribution setting model = "t". heavy tail specified degree freedom parameter df. Note observations scaled sqrt((df-2)/2) error term variance equal one. Asymmetric returns obtained "skew_gaussian" model. asymmetric governed skewness parameter alpha. called leverage model, allow correlation log-returns volatility can simulated setting model "leverage" specifying correlation parameter rho. "skew_gaussian_leverage" model return shock z_t skew gaussian mean zero, unit variance shape alpha, drives volatility shock: h_{t+1} = phi * h_t + sigma_h * (rho * z_t + sqrt(1 - rho^2) * e_t), e_t standard gaussian.
